_source: pak_out/data.cdb 'item' sheet, type startswith BaseBuilding_ or == BaseBuilding

command_centers.name: Base Command Center
command_centers.desc: This central building provides the basic storage, electric power and administrative systems needed to operate a small land base. Deploying a base constitutes a legal claim over the area and deposits it is placed over. It also comes with basic manual smelting and crafting machines.

command_centers.name: Command Tower
command_centers.desc: This building allows a base to expand over a Level 2 land area, doubling its maximum footprint and unlocking experience thresholds up to 800 points.

command_centers.name: Command Relay
command_centers.desc: This building allows a base to expand over a Level 3 land area, doubling its maximum footprint and unlocking experience thresholds up to 2000 points.

command_centers.name: Corporation Command Center
command_centers.desc: A legally sanctionned corporation of importance often requires a place to centralized its operation. This building increases the maximum size of a single base of the corporation and contains crafting machines, a conference room, and many customizable space.

buildings.name: Extractor
buildings.desc: This building can only be assembled over a resource deposit, which it will then drill into to extract raw ore automatically.

buildings.name: Liquid Extractor
buildings.desc: This building can only be assembled over a geothermal pool, from which it will extract pure fluid automatically.

buildings.name: Solar Plant
buildings.desc: This building converts electromagnetic radiation into electric current, supplying the base's power grid. It takes up space and must be oriented correctly, but it operates without fuel.

buildings.name: Warehouse
buildings.desc: This building is suitable for storing solid materials, which can be easily moved in and out by drones.

buildings.name: Drone Dispatcher
buildings.desc: This building can monitor multiple drone routes and merge them into full-fledged production chains. The backbone of a well-organized pipeline.

buildings.name: Trading Box
buildings.desc: This small box let anyone from the same corporation than the base owner leave, or take, gifts.

buildings.name: Cistern
buildings.desc: This building is suitable for storing liquid or semi-fluid materials.

buildings.name: Mag-Plasma Cistern
buildings.desc: This building is suitable for storing active mag-plasma.

buildings.name: Cosmic Condenser
buildings.desc: [NOT IMPL] Building that produce mag-plasma slowly, based on some local properties (maybe proximity from other condensator, and space station reduce production)

buildings.name: Crystallizer
buildings.desc: This building uses chemical solutions to generate crystals at exceptionally high speeds compared to their natural formation process.

buildings.name: Xenic Farm
buildings.desc: This building provides an appropriate environment to cultivate living organisms.

buildings.name: Antimatter Synthesizer
buildings.desc: This building consumes huge amounts of electricity to produce trace amounts of antimatter, which is still rather remarkable.

buildings.name: Laboratory
buildings.desc: This building contains a compact Ninmah laboratory with everything needed to analyze exotic substances.

buildings.name: Fuel Power Plant
buildings.desc: This building consumes carbon-based fuel to produce electric current, supplying the base's power grid. It is effective and compact, but resource-intensive.

buildings.name: Advanced Fuel Power Plant
buildings.desc: [NOT IMPL]

buildings.name: Fusion Plant
buildings.desc: [NOT IMPL]

buildings.name: Heat Capacitor
buildings.desc: [NOT IMPL] reduce temperature around the base. Produce power based on current temperature

buildings.name: Power Transmitter
buildings.desc: This building exploits cutting-edge shield technology and gravitational spacetime deformation to beam electricity without loss between different bases in the same stellar system.

buildings.name: Battery Array
buildings.desc: This building stores chemical energy when the power grid produces excess power. It can then readily convert that energy back to electricity during spikes in consumption.

buildings.name: Assembler
buildings.desc: This building assembles basic resources into industrial compounds. As an automated alternative to the manual workshop, it can function continuously with no human input, which makes it appropriate for large-scale production.

buildings.name: Factory
buildings.desc: The biggest ship materials can only be built in a custom large-scale factory that consumes a lot of energy.

buildings.name: Smelter
buildings.desc: This building converts raw ore into industrial ingots. As an automated alternative to the manual smelter, it can function continuously with no human input, which makes it appropriate for large-scale production.

buildings.name: Micro-Furnace
buildings.desc: Meitner & Karls have refined the process of turning ore into ingots with this micro-furnace. Smaller and faster than a regular smelter, it's the perfect accessory for your days of heavy manual crafting.

buildings.name: Chemical Factory
buildings.desc: This building assembles chemical elements into industrial compounds. It can function continuously with no human input, which makes it appropriate for large-scale production.

buildings.name: Bottling Plant
buildings.desc: This building packages liquid or semi-fluid products into standardized containers.

buildings.name: Recycling Plant
buildings.desc: This building processes scraps to extract their various components and prepare them for industrial reuse.

buildings.name: Shuttle Landing Pad
buildings.desc: This platform allows a shuttle to dock on the base, transporting goods into and out of it.

buildings.name: Landing Pad
buildings.desc: This platform allows a ship to dock on the base and connect to its distribution system to transfer fuel or other fluids.

buildings.name: Shipyard
buildings.desc: This platform allows a ship to dock on the base to have its structure modified and its modules replaced. It is similar to the shipyards of space stations.

buildings.name: Stand-alone Foundation
buildings.desc: [DEPRECATED]

buildings.name: Pathway Stand
buildings.desc:
This towering structure can keep an existing spacetime tunnel stable, even in the gravitational well of a planet. A ship can travel through such a pathway with their regular FTL engine.
Requires the deployment of a [PathwayAmmo] with a [PathwayPuncher] at the exit point.

buildings.name: Atmo-dome Generator
buildings.desc: [NOT IMPL] Building that reduces or negates entirely weather pattern and environmental stuff around the base and in a tube above it, up to space, allowing ship that are not equipped for it to interact with the base.

buildings.name: Observatory
buildings.desc: [NOT IMPL] Building that allow either the owner or its corporation to see invisible FTL pathways and remove the required level to use an FTL pathway, up to a certain range.

buildings.name: Hypergate
buildings.desc: [NOT IMPL] Building that allows the creation of a tunnel toward a hypergate beacon from the same corporation. Consume a lot of power.

buildings.name: Sun Station
buildings.desc: [NOT IMPL] Space Building that produce a huge amount of power from a nearby star. Damage itself when its batteries are full.

buildings.name: Test deco
buildings.desc: This building is only a decoration, but style is often the difference between good contractors and great ones.
